nina: quick update from the micro-prefetch + batch-pack canary on dedicated-small. net positive across latency and cost. :rocket:

eli: TL;DR?

nina: median latency ~-19%, p95 ~-8%, p99 unchanged, token cost ~-26%. throughput +15% on mixed traffic.

tara: bench paste + flags plz.

nina: bench (pool: gd-dedicated-small, model: rw-7b-econ):

CANARY SUMMARY 2026-03-24 11:02 UTC
Model: rw-7b-econ
Profile: mixed (45% gen / 55% chat)
Baseline: p50=70ms p95=205ms p99=318ms tokens/s=940 cost=$0.0119/1k
Canary: p50=57ms p95=189ms p99=322ms tokens/s=1081 cost=$0.0088/1k
Delta: p50 -18.6% p95 -7.8% p99 +1.3% throughput +15% unit-cost -26.1%
Flags: micro_prefetch=true, batch_pack.strategy=pack-light, seq_gate=2800

ci-bot: health checks: latency ok, error-rate=0.07%, mem pressure low.

eli: edge cases? long contexts? many short completions?

nina: long contexts >2800 show minor mem-read jitter; short completions (<6 tokens) are slightly faster. Plan: hold prefetch for seq_len>2800.

ops-bot: created INF-4982 "Show micro-prefetch projected savings in Console" assigned to tara. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4982

tara: will add a projected-savings card on model page (est 1d) and check reserved pricing impact.

pm-jas: can we get a 1-liner for sales / release notes if GA goes well?

nina: yes  will draft blurb and bench link. Rollout plan: canary -> 30% tonight -> 75% tomorrow AM -> full GA after 12h stable. Kill switch: flip micro_prefetch=false on pool via console or API.

eli: add alert for p99 regressions and seq_len regressions with 10min window.

nina: added alerts + dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/micro-prefetch-2960012345

pm-jas: great work, measurable win and low risk. thumbs up. :tada:
